name: Luck Rap
description: Rap the foe at the instant a stroke of luck is about to favor the user.

name: Nudged Cover
description: Nudge the chance of each blow a little against the foe so that cover is found where none was set.

name: Fortunate Slip
description: Slip aside at the moment a lucky gap opens in the foe's line of attack.

name: Hunch Gauge
description: Gauge how strong a hunch really is by the weight of the thread that it pulls on.

name: Reversed Odds
description: Reverse the odds of a clash so that the foe's best blow turns out their worst.

name: Evasive Omen
description: Read an omen of harm in the foe's shoulder and throw the blow off its line before it is begun.

name: Gambler's Calm
description: Settle into the cold calm of one who has weighed every throw and fear leaves the hands.

name: Misfortune Blow
description: Land a blow that carries a thread of bad luck so that the foe's next several acts all go slightly wrong.

name: Calamity Turn
description: Turn a stroke of foul luck into a calamity that falls on the foe's weakest part just as they commit.

name: Loom Rap
description: Rap the foe with a shuttle-quick fist at the point where two threads cross.

name: Woven Cover
description: Weave the nearest threads of the hour into a thin cover that turns the first blow.

name: Shuttle Step
description: Pass between two threads like a shuttle and come out where the foe is not.

name: Hour Gauge
description: Gauge what the coming hour holds by the number and tightness of threads that run into it.

name: Warp Steady
description: Hold the user's own threads taut like the warp of a loom so that effort is not wasted.

name: Weft Binding
description: Pass a weft thread through the foe's limbs so that they are drawn together and held.

name: Weaver's Parry
description: Catch the foe's blow in a loop of thread and pull it past the body into an answering stroke.

name: Hour Reading
description: Read the woven cloth of the next hour across the whole field and mark where it is worn thin.

name: Cutting Shuttle
description: Drive a shuttle of qi through the weak place of the cloth and into the foe behind it.

name: Tapestry Ward
description: Hang a great tapestry of dense threads between the user and the foe that no single blow can part.

name: Paired Lot
description: Cast two lots at the foe in one blow so that at least one falls well.

name: Twin Chance Cover
description: Hold two chances of safety at once so that if one fails the other still holds.

name: Doubled Pace
description: Cross the gap in a pace that is doubled by foresight and leaves the foe a pace behind.

name: Dual Omen
description: Read a good omen and an ill omen at once and judge which is the stronger.

name: Counter Fate
description: Hand the foe the fate they meant for the user and answer with the same blow.

name: Paired Misfortune
description: Lay two small misfortunes on the foe at once so that both the weapon and the stance fail.

name: Fate Duet
description: Strike in duet with the foe's own fate so that the blow lands at the very moment they are most exposed.

name: Mirrored Lot
description: Mirror the lot that falls on the user and return it whole to the one who cast it.

name: Dropping Lot
description: Let the lot drop from above on the foe in a plunging blow aimed at the unguarded crown.

name: Fallen Guard
description: Bring the guard down in the one place the odds say the next blow will fall.

name: Hawk Foresight
description: See as a hawk sees from a height the shape of the fight below and the place a blow will fall.

name: Stoop Fortune
description: Gather luck into the instant before a stoop so that the strike lands with all its weight.

name: Swoop Pace
description: Swoop across the gap on a thread of luck and arrive just inside the foe's reach.

name: Falling Doom
description: Bring a downward stroke upon a foe that fate has marked as the next to fall.

name: Sharp Foresight
description: Hold a sharp clear vision of the next two blows that the foe will throw.

name: Lot Snare
description: Cast a snare of tangled chances about one foe so that each move they make draws it tighter.

name: Hawk's Verdict
description: Pass a verdict from a height with a stroke that finds the exact thread on which the foe's life hangs.

name: Ordained Strike
description: Strike where fate has ordained the foe will be and leave them slowed by the certainty of it.

name: Omen Rap
description: Rap the foe at the moment an ill omen shows in their stance.

name: Vow Cover
description: Take a vow to the wind and let its keeping cover the user against the first blow.

name: Omen Step
description: Take the step an omen warns is the safe one and no other.

name: Omen Reading
description: Read the small signs of wind and breath that go before a danger and name the direction it comes from.

name: Sworn Doom
description: Swear the foe to the doom that the omen showed and strike to make the oath come true.

name: Vowed Ward
description: Ward the body with an oath that fate cannot be made to break against the user.

name: Omen Cast
description: Cast an omen upon the near hours and read from its fall whether to press or to wait.

name: Forsworn Doom
description: Bring a doom upon a foe who has broken an oath so that their blows fall short and their guard is slow.

name: Vowed Fortune
description: Vow fortune upon an ally and the user so that the next trial goes their way if they hold to the vow.

name: Taut Cord
description: Strike along a taut cord of fate that runs straight from the fist to the foe's weak point.

name: Held Fortune
description: Hold a store of good fortune close about the body and spend it on the blows that matter.

name: Bearing Pace
description: Step on a fixed bearing and let fate keep the path under the feet open.

name: Cord Reading
description: Feel the cords that bind a person to what they will do and tell which ones are strained.

name: Oath Luck
description: Bind the user's luck to a sworn purpose so that small chances fall in its favor.

name: Mending Skein
description: Wind a skein of good chance around a hurt ally or the self until small wounds close and pain ebbs.

name: Fixed Bearing
description: Fix the foe to a bearing that fate has chosen so that they cannot turn from it.

name: Fate Anchor
description: Drop an anchor of settled fate that holds the user steady against pushing and pulling blows.

name: Seeking Omen
description: Send a seeking omen across the field to find the fate that is closest to the user and name it.

name: Unerring Doom
description: Loose a doom that has been sworn to a single mark so that it does not miss while the oath is held.

name: Steadfast Weal
description: Pour a steady weal of fortune into an ally or the self that carries through the length of a fight.
